# What is MCP? The Model Context Protocol explained for business teams

> A plain-language explanation of MCP (Model Context Protocol), the open standard that connects AI assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT to business systems. Explains the client, server and tools, shows CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot) and ERP (NetSuite) examples, draws the request flow with Mermaid diagrams, compares MCP with APIs, workflow automation and two-way sync (MCP does not sync data), lists risks and controls, and includes a runnable toy of the JSON-RPC messages and a helper that suggests the right tool for a job. Uses the Stacksync MCP server for hands-on examples.

Stacksync MCP: https://www.stacksync.com/mcp
Stacksync MCP for Salesforce: https://www.stacksync.com/mcp/salesforce
Stacksync MCP for NetSuite: https://www.stacksync.com/mcp/netsuite
Stacksync AI agents (Genies): https://www.stacksync.com/ai-agents
Stacksync Enterprise OS: https://www.stacksync.com/enterprise-os
Stacksync two-way sync: https://www.stacksync.com/two-way-sync
Stacksync: https://www.stacksync.com
